subject: Draft: Platform strategy shift + role alignments for Q3 OKR check-in
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Strategy Partners <insights@strategypartners.com>
Date: 2027-06-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Draft: Platform strategy shift + role alignments for Q3 OKR check-in

Team — attaching a working draft of the leadership note I plan to share in the QBR and with a subset of managers next week. High-level ask: please review the talking points and the proposed org-chart overlay for product/platform roles. Specific asks below.

TL;DR: We need to shift ~20% of product engineering focus from experimental model experiments into a dedicated Platform Reliability stream to meet Q3 latency and cost OKRs. That change implies two role alignments: create a Platform Lead (senior IC -> people manager) and re-scope two PMs to Platform Program owners.

Please: 1) Read the talking points in the attached Q3_OKR_talking_points_v2.docx; 2) Confirm the org-chart in org-chart-proposal.png (feedback inline in Drive link); 3) Call out any downstream customer or sales risks (cc'd Sarah at Acme for visibility).

Notes on timing: want to finalize language by 6/15 so legal and comms can pre-review for the executive email on 6/20.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Q3_OKR_talking_points_v2.docx (docx), org-chart-proposal.png (image)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-11T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft: Platform strategy shift + role alignments for Q3 OKR check-in

Marissa — solid framing. A couple quick edits inline (see Drive). Two immediate flags: 1) Please soften the wording around "shift" — managers will worry about headcount reduction even though this is a reallocation. Suggest "refocus" + explicit reassurance there's no net reduction. 2) We should call out the customer risk triage and our mitigation plan (page 2) — customers on beta models (Acme included) need an SLA review.

Minor: swap the order so the OKR impact comes before the org change; executives care about outcomes first. Also recommend we share a short FAQ for managers to use in team syncs. I can draft the FAQ if you want.

Lauren
Lauren Bishop
VP, People Operations

Subject: Re: Draft: Platform strategy shift + role alignments for Q3 OKR check-in

Thanks — reviewed the doc. I'm supportive of the Platform Reliability stream, but a couple product/engineering considerations: 1) We need a clear migration plan for ongoing experimental work so we don't stall model evaluation cadence (proposal: 6-week rolling buffer). 2) The new Platform Lead should have a strong background in inference serving and cost engineering; I recommend we identify two internal candidates (Rishi and Chloe) before we go external.

I've added comments in the Drive doc and attached a short spreadsheet with estimated resource-hours for the first 12 weeks (link in Drive). If we commit this quarter, the projected throughput improvements should hit our per-token latency OKR within 9 weeks.

Vivek
Director, Serving Runtime

Subject: Re: Draft: Platform strategy shift + role alignments for Q3 OKR check-in

Marissa — flagged a legal/compensation note: moving an IC to a manager role requires a compensation calibration and candidate discussion with HR. Lauren, can you own the manager comp calibration and candidate talk-track? Also, we need to run this with Sales leadership — Monica, can you get Chris to weigh in on any quota/commission exposures for customers tied to the experimental roadmap?

On product specifics: the "Platform Program owner" wording is a little vague; suggest we call it "Platform Program Manager — Reliability" so it reads clearly in job postings and internal transfers.

Karthik
Chief Product Officer

Subject: Final draft for legal/comms review — Platform reliability focus + role naming

Team — thanks for the feedback. I've incorporated the tone change ("refocus"), added the customer mitigation bullets, renamed the role to "Platform Program Manager — Reliability", and included a 6-week buffer for experimental work in the transition plan. Attached are the revised artifacts and a short manager FAQ (added to the Drive link).

Next steps: 1) Lauren — please lead comp calibration and finalize the manager FAQ by 6/17. 2) Monica — loop Sales leadership and confirm there are no quota exclusions by 6/16. 3) Karthik/Vivek — finalize candidate shortlist by 6/18 so we can share with Talent.

If there are no legal redlines, I'll submit to Comms and Legal this afternoon for an exec send on 6/20.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Product Operations
